name: animate-pls
description: Make short animated videos in code (explainers, histories, product films, little stories) as single-file canvas videos rendered to MP4 in 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9. A free local voice-over with VoxCPM2 in your own cloned voice (or a designed one, or ElevenLabs by hand); a one-take format where every beat is carried into the next; seven styles built in or a new one from your references; intake, story / look / storyboard check-ins, then a measured build.
